In Honor of Jean-Michel Basquiat
More Info GET TICKETS

Created and performed by Roger Guenveur Smith
Live sound design by Marc Anthony Thompson

September 9, 2026—October 10, 2026

Read Synopsis

On the heels of the acclaimed sold-out run during Under the Radar, Obie Award-winning actor, playwright and director Roger Guenveur Smith performs an intimate one-man show honoring his friend and collaborator Jean-Michel Basquiat.

Wild Rose
More Info GET TICKETS

By Nicole Taylor
Choreography by Steven Hoggett & Vicki Manderson
Music supervision by Sarah Travis & Nadia DiGiallonardo
Directed by John Tiffany

November 24, 2026—January 10, 2027

Read Synopsis

From BAFTA-winner Nicole Taylor and renowned director John Tiffany (Harry Potter and the Cursed Child, Once), Wild Rose is an uplifting and heartwarming new musical about motherhood, dreams and finding your three chords and the truth.

The Grief Eater Near North Bender
More Info JOIN NOW & SAVE

By Dylan Guerra
Directed by Dustin Wills
Produced in association with Roundabout Theatre Company

January 21, 2027—March 21, 2027

Read Synopsis

The Grief Eater Near North Bender is a fierce and darkly funny descent into love, loss, and the cost of facing what we’d rather outrun. Ready or not.

Blood Be Sweet
More Info JOIN NOW & SAVE

By Abigail C. Onwunali
Directed by Awoye Timpo

April 21, 2027—May 30, 2027

Read Synopsis

Obie Award winner Awoye Timpo directs this poetic ritual drama written by former NYTW 2050 Artistic Fellow Abigail C. Onwunali. From New York City to Nigeria, Blood Be Sweet is a conversation between the seen and unseen, duty and defiance, sacrifice and survival.
